message:
We all know that one person who seems gloriously over-prepared for anything life might throw their way. You know, the friend who has a go-bag packed for a zombie apocalypse, a power outage, and a surprise camping trip all rolled into one? 🌟

Well, I had a moment last week when I realized just how handy it can be. During a sudden storm, while others scrambled to find flashlights, I found myself sipping tea by candlelight, thanks to my own little stash of supplies. 

It got us thinking: maybe being a bit over-prepared isn’t such a bad thing after all. What’s your favorite tip or trick for staying ready? We’d love to hear!
